expenses.title: How an expense claim gets checked
expenses.aria: How an expense claim gets checked, in 6 steps
expenses.alt: The whole flow at once: Ana's phone with a green Paid tick, three receipt cards (hotel $180, dinner $95, taxi $40) under an expense policy, each with a coloured reason (under the limit, over the $60 meal limit, no photo), a manager's Approved note, and an expense report with a total of $275.
